start: ^I was expecting you. The city has quietly been carrying words too small for crowds.
^They gathered at the upper room of John Mark's house last Sabbath. Twelve sat at the table. One was silent before the bread was broken.
^Eleven sang and broke and poured. One had already agreed on the price of betrayal.

s: ^Who was the one who said nothing?
^What did the bread and cup become?
